input: My CultPass app keeps freezing whenever I open it. Can you help me with this?
expected_output: Please try force closing and reopening the app, and make sure you're on the latest version from the App Store or Google Play. If it still freezes, try clearing the app cache on Android or rebooting your device. If the issue continues, let me know your device model and OS version so I can help further.
context:
Title: Troubleshooting App Crashes or Freezes

If a user reports that the CultPass app is crashing:

- Ask them to force close the app and relaunch
- Confirm they are on the latest app version (App Store or Google Play)
- Suggest clearing app cache (Android) or rebooting the device
- If the problem persists, collect device model + OS version and escalate

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please try closing and reopening the app, and make sure you're on the latest version. If the issue continues, let me know your device model and OS version so I can help further."

input: I got charged twice for CultPass this month and I want a refund.

input: I want to stop my subscription, but I don’t see any option for that in my account.
expected_output: You can cancel your subscription at any time via the CultPass app under 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'; cancellation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle. - Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead
